tithi: .input {$ends :string} .match $ends sameDay {{The tithi is {$tithi :entity kind=tithi} of {$paksha :entity kind=paksha} until {$until :time}.}} nextDay {{The tithi is {$tithi :entity kind=tithi} of {$paksha :entity kind=paksha} until {$until :time} the next day.}} allDay {{The tithi is {$tithi :entity kind=tithi} of {$paksha :entity kind=paksha} all day.}} * {{The tithi is {$tithi :entity kind=tithi} of {$paksha :entity kind=paksha} for the rest of the day.}}
nakshatra: .input {$ends :string} .match $ends sameDay {{The nakshatra is {$nakshatra :entity kind=nakshatra} until {$until :time}.}} nextDay {{The nakshatra is {$nakshatra :entity kind=nakshatra} until {$until :time} the next day.}} allDay {{The nakshatra is {$nakshatra :entity kind=nakshatra} all day.}} * {{The nakshatra is {$nakshatra :entity kind=nakshatra} for the rest of the day.}}
yoga: .input {$ends :string} .match $ends sameDay {{The yoga is {$yoga :entity kind=yoga} until {$until :time}.}} nextDay {{The yoga is {$yoga :entity kind=yoga} until {$until :time} the next day.}} allDay {{The yoga is {$yoga :entity kind=yoga} all day.}} * {{The yoga is {$yoga :entity kind=yoga} for the rest of the day.}}
karana: .input {$ends :string} .match $ends sameDay {{The karana is {$karana :entity kind=karana} until {$until :time}.}} nextDay {{The karana is {$karana :entity kind=karana} until {$until :time} the next day.}} allDay {{The karana is {$karana :entity kind=karana} all day.}} * {{The karana is {$karana :entity kind=karana} for the rest of the day.}}
sun: The Sun rises at {$rise :time} and sets at {$set :time}.
sunUp: The Sun stays above the horizon all day.
sunDown: The Sun stays below the horizon all day.
sankranti: .input {$when :string} .match $when nextDay {{The Sun enters {$rashi :entity kind=rashi} at {$at :time} the next day.}} * {{The Sun enters {$rashi :entity kind=rashi} at {$at :time}.}}
moonSign: .input {$ends :string} .match $ends sameDay {{The Moon stands in {$rashi :entity kind=rashi} until {$until :time}.}} nextDay {{The Moon stands in {$rashi :entity kind=rashi} until {$until :time} the next day.}} allDay {{The Moon stands in {$rashi :entity kind=rashi} all day.}} * {{The Moon stands in {$rashi :entity kind=rashi} for the rest of the day.}}
moonrise: .input {$when :string} .match $when nextDay {{The Moon rises at {$at :time} the next day.}} * {{The Moon rises at {$at :time}.}}
moonset: .input {$when :string} .match $when nextDay {{The Moon sets at {$at :time} the next day.}} * {{The Moon sets at {$at :time}.}}
month: .input {$kind :string} .match $kind adhika {{The lunar month is adhika {$masa :entity kind=masa}.}} * {{The lunar month is {$masa :entity kind=masa}.}}
